title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks
hook_text: Factory robots switch tasks in minutes
script:
Industrial Next cut factory robot retooling down from weeks to just minutes.
The company helps manufacturers automate complex and delicate tasks.
These precision jobs have traditionally required human labor.
Traditional factory setups often take weeks to reprogram for new products.
This speed helps factories adapt instantly to changing consumer demands.
Would you trust a robot to build your car?
